kill_verdict_iii.condition_as_stated_in_the_handoff: If the Duman et al. reduction is concretely tight at ML-KEM parameters, the multi-target advantage is bounded by the reduction loss, the mechanism has no room, and this campaign closes on a citation at zero compute.
kill_verdict_iii.one_line: The campaign does not close on a citation to Duman et al.
kill_verdict_iii.basis: The DHKLS full text is UNOBTAINABLE, so tightness could not be checked in that paper. It was checked in the only readable source that addresses the question: Bernstein ePrint 2022/1580 Appendix A.4, read in full. That appendix reports the claim is (a) explicitly conditional on unlimited-sample MLWE hardness rather than unconditional or concrete, (b) supported by a proof outline with three steps Bernstein states are unjustified there, (c) undermined in the relevant range because Arora-Ge breaks many-sample MLWE for the Kyber error distribution at a feasible sample count, and (d) specifically not established for many ciphertexts per ONE key -- which is exactly this campaign's setting. Bernstein records the flaws as disclosed 2022-11-04 privately and 2022-11-14 publicly, with no response from the DHKLS authors as of 2023-03-17. Separately, the DHKLS abstract (read, HTTP 200) is about the FO transform and prefix hashing and does not contain the multi-target IND-CPA statement at all.
kill_verdict_iii.residual_uncertainty: This rests on one party's -- and an adversarial party's -- rendering of a paper I could not read. A Reviewer should obtain ePrint 2021/1351 and check the quotations at page 3 and footnote 2 before the verdict is treated as settled. Whether DHKLS responded after 2023-03-17, or whether later work established the tight multi-ciphertext-per-key reduction, was not checked.
kill_verdict_iii.what_this_verdict_does_not_say: It does not say the mechanism has room at ML-KEM parameters, and it does not say DHKLS is wrong. Bernstein himself declines to say the heuristics are accurate, and his footnote 19 names the concrete ML-KEM question as not addressed by his asymptotics. No status of any hypothesis, evidence record, or knowledge entry is changed by this task.
